briefFull: "Scheme for Waiver of Loans to Handloom and Powerloom Sector" redeems the debt accrued by the farmers, Self-Help Groups, Weavers, etc., to the Scheduled Commercial Banks/Cooperative Banks, Urban Cooperative Banks, and RRBs, through their Branches/Institutions in the State of Andhra Pradesh.
details:
"Scheme for Waiver of Loans to Handloom and Powerloom Sector" is a Loan Waiver Scheme by the Industries and Commerce Dept., Govt. of Andhra Pradesh. The scheme redeems the debt accrued by the farmers, Self-Help Groups, Weavers, etc., to the Scheduled Commercial Banks/Cooperative Banks, Urban Cooperative Banks, and RRBs, through their Branches/Institutions in the State of Andhra Pradesh. The scheme also suggests a number of measures for increased livelihood opportunities and improved prosperity. The scheme has a specific focus on - 
1. Weavers’ Individual Loans 
2. Weavers’ Groups Loans 
3. Loans of Power loom Units below 5 HP Power connection and availing 50% power subsidy scheme.
documentsRequired:
- Domicile/Residential Certificate / Proof of Address
- Income Certificate
- Aadhar Card
- Passport Size Photograph
- Loan Statement
- Land Documents
- Sanction Letter issued by the Banks
- Details of the Bank Account

faqs.q: When Was The Government Order Of The Scheme Guidelines First Issued?
faqs.a: The Government Order of the Scheme Guidelines was first issued on 1st January 2016.
faqs.qTe: పథకం మార్గదర్శకాల యొక్క ప్రభుత్వ ఉత్తర్వు మొదట ఎప్పుడు జారీ చేయబడింది?

faqs.q: What Are The Objectives Of This Scheme?
faqs.a: The objectives of this scheme are to redeem the debt accrued by the farmers, Self-help Groups, Weavers, etc., to the Scheduled Commercial Banks / Cooperative Banks, Urban Cooperative Banks, and RRBs, through their Branches/Institutions in the State of Andhra Pradesh. The scheme also suggests a number of measures for increased livelihood opportunities and improved prosperity.

faqs.q: Does This Scheme Have A Special Focus On A Particular Type Of Loan?
faqs.a:
Yes, the scheme has a specific focus on - 
1. Weavers' Individual Loans 
2. Weavers' Groups Loans 
3. Loans of Power loom Units below 5 HP Power connection and availing 50% power subsidy scheme.
faqs.qTe: ఈ పథకం ఒక నిర్దిష్ట రకం రుణంపై ప్రత్యేక దృష్టి పెడుతుందా?

faqs.q: Are The Loans Taken From RRBs Also In The Scope Of This Scheme?
faqs.a: Yes, the scheme applies to the loans taken for weaving purposes extended by Scheduled Commercial Banks/Cooperative Banks, Urban Coop. Banks and RRBs, through their branches/Institutions in the State of Andhra Pradesh.
faqs.qTe: ఆర్ఆర్బీల నుండి తీసుకున్న రుణాలు కూడా ఈ పథకం పరిధిలోకి వస్తాయా?

faqs.q: Are The Loans Taken From The Banks Outside The State Of Andhra Pradesh Also In The Scope Of This Scheme?
faqs.a: No, loans taken from banks located outside the State of Andhra Pradesh are not in the scope of this scheme.
faqs.qTe: ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ రాష్ట్రం వెలుపల ఉన్న బ్యాంకుల నుండి తీసుకున్న రుణాలు కూడా ఈ పథకం పరిధిలోకి వస్తాయా?

faqs.q: Are Individual Weavers Also Covered In This Scheme?
faqs.a: Yes, the loans disbursed to Individual Weavers and Weaver Groups for weaving purposes that were outstanding on 31.03.2014 are eligible for coverage under the scheme.
faqs.qTe: వ్యక్తిగత నేత కార్మికులు కూడా ఈ పథకం పరిధిలోకి వస్తారా?

faqs.q: What Is The Upper Ceiling Prescribed For Individual Weaver?
faqs.a: The total amount eligible for redemption of loans taken for weaving purposes shall be limited to ₹ 1,00,000 for Individual Weaver.
faqs.qTe: వ్యక్తిగత నేత కోసం సూచించిన ఎగువ పైకప్పు ఏమిటి?

faqs.q: What Is The Upper Ceiling Prescribed For Weaver Groups?
faqs.a: The total amount eligible for redemption of loans taken for weaving purposes shall be limited to ₹ 5,00,000 for Weaver Groups, subject to the condition that within the Weaver Groups, the eligibility for the redemption of the loan outstanding per individual will be limited to ₹ 1,00,000.
faqs.qTe: నేత కార్మికుల సమూహాలకు సూచించిన ఎగువ పరిమితి ఏమిటి?

faqs.q: How Will The Eligible Beneficiaries Be Identified For This Scheme?
faqs.a: The Assistant Director (H&T), shall obtain the list of potential beneficiaries from the Banks.
faqs.qTe: ఈ పథకానికి అర్హులైన లబ్ధిదారులను ఎలా గుర్తిస్తారు?

faqs.q: How Will The Amount Of The Scheme Benefit Be Provided In The Case Of Individual Beneficiaries?
faqs.a: All payments will be routed through the bank where the debt is outstanding directly to the account of the beneficiary.
faqs.qTe: వ్యక్తిగత లబ్ధిదారుల విషయంలో పథకం యొక్క మొత్తం ప్రయోజనం ఎలా అందించబడుతుంది?

faqs.q: How Will The Amount Of The Scheme Benefit Be Provided In The Case Of Beneficiary Groups?
faqs.a: In the case of the groups, the payment will be made to the group account director, and the members of the group in turn will apportion the money in the ratio appropriate.
faqs.qTe: లబ్ధిదారుల సమూహాల విషయంలో పథకం యొక్క మొత్తం ప్రయోజనం ఎలా అందించబడుతుంది?

faqs.q: Where Can I Find The Telugu Translation Of The Scheme Guidelines?
faqs.a: A copy of this scheme in English and Telugu Languages shall be displayed in each branch of every lending institution covered under this scheme.
faqs.qTe: పథకం మార్గదర్శకాల తెలుగు అనువాదం నాకు ఎక్కడ దొరుకుతుంది?

faqs.q: Can I Apply To This Scheme If The Annual Income Of My Family (From All Sources) Is More Than ₹ 8,00,000?
faqs.a: There are no income-related criteria for this scheme. You can apply to this scheme irrespective of your family income, provided that you meet the eligibility criteria for this scheme.
faqs.qTe: నా కుటుంబ వార్షిక ఆదాయం (అన్ని వనరుల నుండి) ₹ 8,00,000 కంటే ఎక్కువగా ఉంటే నేను ఈ పథకానికి దరఖాస్తు చేయవచ్చా?

faqs.q: Can I Apply To This Scheme If I Am Above 35 Years Of Age?
faqs.a: There are no age-related criteria for this scheme. You can apply to this scheme irrespective of your age, provided that you meet the eligibility criteria for this scheme.
faqs.qTe: నా వయస్సు 35 ఏళ్లు దాటితే నేను ఈ పథకానికి దరఖాస్తు చేయవచ్చా?

faqs.q: Are There Any Age-Related Criteria For This Scheme?
faqs.a: No, there are no age-related criteria mentioned in the scheme guidelines for this scheme.
faqs.qTe: ఈ పథకానికి ఏదైనా వయస్సు-సంబంధిత ప్రమాణాలు ఉన్నాయా?

faqs.q: Can A Domicile Of Telangana Also Apply To This Scheme?
faqs.a: No, in order to be eligible to apply, the applicant should be a resident/domicile of the state of Andhra Pradesh.
faqs.qTe: తెలంగాణ నివాసం కూడా ఈ పథకానికి దరఖాస్తు చేయవచ్చా?

faqs.q: Is This Scheme State Sponsored Or Centrally Sponsored?
faqs.a: This scheme is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme.
faqs.qTe: ఈ పథకం రాష్ట్ర ప్రాయోజితమా లేదా కేంద్ర ప్రాయోజితమా?

faqs.q: Where Can I Find The Link To The Scheme Guidelines?
faqs.a: The Scheme Guidelines can be found at this link - https://www.aphandtex.gov.in/open_record.php?ID=142
faqs.qTe: పథకం మార్గదర్శకాలకు లింక్ను నేను ఎక్కడ కనుగొనగలను?
